introduction: WOOKTOOL hex key wrench sets support professional, hardware and private-label programs that need an organized metric or inch size sequence with a suitable holder and retail presentation. Buyers can define the required range and end style around the market need.

For quotation, provide the size standard, ball-end requirement, finish, holder or package direction, quantity, target market and branding needs. These points help confirm a practical sample and inspection plan.

faq.question: Can the hex key set use metric or inch sizing?
faq.answer: Metric and inch size sequences can be reviewed based on the selected set and destination market.

faq.question: What is a ball-end hex key used for?
faq.answer: A ball-end configuration can support angled access in suitable applications; buyers should state whether this feature is required.

faq.question: Can the holder and packaging be customized?
faq.answer: Holder format, retail packaging, barcode, logo and carton marks can be reviewed for OEM programs.

faq.question: What quality checks matter for hex key sets?
faq.answer: Checks can include size sequence, end shape, finish, rust prevention, holder fit, packing quantity and carton information.
